title: Ballistic Armor & Protection
description: Large flat/curved plates, multi-curvature shaped panels, bolt holes for mounting
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) is the standard for military vehicle armor (MIL-DTL-46077), offering 40% weight savings vs rolled steel armor at equivalent ballistic protection.
Form: Hot-rolled plate is the standard armor form. Curved panels require hot forming or thermo-mechanical processing.
engineeringTrends: Process: Hot forming of curved panels
comparisonNotes: Standards: MIL-DTL-46077 Grade 5 armor plate, solution-treated + aged, 100% Brinell hardness + ballistic sample test
